title: Reading Drill — Testing a Digital Recipe Card
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Testing a Digital Recipe Card
passages.body:
**A** A cooking class replaced paper recipe sheets with shared tablets. Students could enlarge the text, but found it difficult to touch the screen while wearing gloves.

**B** The designer added large next and back controls. In the next trial a clean partner could move between steps while the cook kept both hands on the work surface.

**C** Some students still preferred paper. The class paired the digital instructions with a printable shopping list and let participants decide which format to use at home.
